programmes.d: The fans are in for a treat with this special episode which opens the archives to the best of the show’s bad takes, flubs and flops, many of which have never been screened before.

The Marvel comic maestros are put under the MythBusters microscope.
Can mirrors be used to make a death ray? Is it possible to make a moving SUV flip end over end by punching down on the hood, like in the film "Hellboy?"

Jamie and Adam test a mythical steam-powered confederate weapon.

Can an object fired backward from a vehicle moving forward simply fall to the ground? Do the spy movie car tricks to escape a chasing car work?
The team tests whether dynamite can create ideal surfing conditions.
